correctness.rationale: Primeness/CI for M>=5 is supplied by arxiv:2512.25058v1 Theorems 1,2,7.7. At rank2, a nonzero hollow symmetric 4x4 relation has rank2 and factors through a binary quadratic space; its diagonal-zero columns lie on two isotropic lines, giving exactly two disjoint-support dependencies. Rank>=3 is smooth, rank<=1 is included. Pairwise orthogonality then exhausts A,T,R,P, and proper irreducible incidences with generic uniqueness give each dimension 2M-1 and exact count 6+4+12+3. The verifier checks 108 explicit Jacobian witnesses and all 116 rank-two hollow 4x4 matrices over F3, while universal reasoning is in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The complete reduced singular-support classification of the natural four-vector orthogonal-frame complete intersection is a geometric invariant: 25 indexed irreducible components in four distinct degeneracy mechanisms, all dimension 2M-1 and exact singular codimension 2M-5 for every M>=5. This is neither merely the known primality/FRS bound nor a trivial counting exercise; the rank-two hollow-matrix splitting and orthogonal-isotropic incidence are essential. It informs future work on resolutions and Jacobian singular schemes without claiming any downstream theorem.
